notes: Ten product facts. Paybill vs Buy Goods is a reference-field distinction anchored in the Lipa na M-PESA page; Fuliza mechanics and the STK Push C2B flow are documented; card products are not.

entries.subject: paybill_definition
entries.value_text: A payment collection service letting a business collect money regularly from customers through M-PESA
entries.display: Paybill = recurring collections against a business shortcode
entries.quote: the paybill service is a payment collection service that allows businesses to collect money regularly from customers through m pesa
entries.notes: Contrast with buy goods: paybill carries an account/reference field, buy goods does not.

entries.subject: buy_goods_definition
entries.value_text: A till-based collection service for distributors, retailers and merchants accepting Lipa na M-PESA
entries.display: Buy Goods = till number, customer pays for goods at the counter
entries.quote: buy goods this service offers distributors retailers and merchants a payment collection service via m pesa customers can pay for goods and services using m pesa to businesses that accept lipa na m pesa services

entries.subject: pochi_la_biashara_function
entries.value_text: Lets a small business receive business funds separately from personal funds on the same M-PESA line
entries.display: Pochi la Biashara separates business and personal money on one SIM
entries.quote: pochi la biashara is a product that allows business owners such as food vendors small kiosk owners boda boda operators secondhand clothes dealers etc to receive and separate business funds from personal funds on their m pesa line

entries.subject: b2b_prerequisite
entries.value_text: The paying organisation must already hold an M-PESA shortcode
entries.display: M-PESA B2B requires an existing shortcode on the paying side
entries.quote: the organization must have an existing m pesa shortcode from which the payment is to be made

entries.subject: business_till_function
entries.value_text: An upgrade of the buy goods till that lets the owner transact directly from collected funds
entries.display: Business till = buy goods till plus spend-from-till
entries.quote: the m pesa business till is an enhancement of the existing lipa na m pesa buy goods till that enables business owners to collect payments on the till and use the money collected to make other transactions directly from their till

entries.subject: mpesa_ussd_code
entries.display: M-PESA menu is reached on USSD 334 (*334#)
entries.quote: via ussd 334 dial 334 select send money select m pesa global
entries.notes: The same code appears across Safaricom pages; app and SIM toolkit are the other M-PESA channels. enum_match set: {*334#}.

entries.subject: fuliza_function
entries.value_text: An M-PESA overdraft that completes a payment when the wallet balance is short, to registered and unregistered recipients, buy goods and paybill
entries.display: Fuliza covers a shortfall so the payment still completes
entries.quote: able to send money to both registered and unregistered customers customer can pay to lipa na m pesa buy goods and paybill

entries.subject: mpesa_not_a_bank
entries.value_text: M-PESA is neither a bank nor a deposit-taking institution; the float is held in trust by M-PESA Holding Company Limited
entries.display: M-PESA balances are trust-held e-money, not bank deposits
entries.quote: you acknowledge that m pesa is neither a bank nor a deposit taking institution
entries.notes: No interest is paid on balances (clause 3.9), consistent with E-Money Regulation 7.5.

entries.subject: daraja_platform
entries.value_text: Safaricom's developer portal exposing M-PESA APIs, sandbox and go-live process
entries.display: Daraja is the API gateway for Lipa na M-PESA, B2C and related M-PESA APIs
entries.quote: daraja 3 0 is a web platform that offers access to safaricom and m pesa apis that creates a bridge for payment integration to web and mobile apps

entries.subject: stk_push_transaction_nature
entries.value_text: M-PESA Express (STK Push) is a merchant-initiated customer-to-business payment carrying a PIN prompt
entries.display: STK Push is C2B: the merchant initiates, the customer authorises with their PIN
entries.quote: lipa na m pesa online api also known as m pesa express is a merchant business initiated c2b customer to business transaction
entries.notes: TransactionType distinguishes the two rails: CustomerPayBillOnline for paybill, CustomerBuyGoodsOnline for till.
